# Env contract

<!-- GENERATED by `python3 scripts/check-env.py --write` from REGISTRY. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every environment variable read by `services/agent/agent` and `apps/web` (excluding e2e), plus
QA-only knobs. `harness/tests/test_check_env.py` fails if code reads a name not listed here.

- **Required** lists the `check-env.py --target` that fails without it.
- **Secret** vars go to `fly secrets import` / Vercel encrypted env; never commit or print them.
- Non-secret agent defaults live in `infra/fly.toml` `[env]`.
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` is inlined into the browser bundle at build time — public by definition.
- *Forbidden* = test doubles that `check-env.py` rejects on that deploy target.
- Renamed from the old scaffold `.env.example`: `DATABASE_URL` → `PERSONA_DATABASE_URL`,
  `TURN_URLS/USERNAME/CREDENTIAL` → `PERSONA_TURN_*` (old names are read by nothing).

Check a target by name only (never prints values):
`python3 scripts/check-env.py --target agent --env-file .persona-deploy/agent.env`

## Core wiring

| Variable | Component | Required | Secret | Default | How to get / generate | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PERSONA_DATABASE_URL` | agent (Fly), local | agent, local | secret | — | Supabase → Project Settings → Database → connection string (session pooler :5432 or direct; `?sslmode=require`) | agent is the single writer; also the argument to scripts/db-migrate.sh |
| `PERSONA_AGENT_BASE_URL` | web (Vercel), local | web, local | no | — | `https://<fly-app>.fly.dev` (no trailing slash) | server-side only; browser never sees it |
| `PERSONA_INTERNAL_SECRET` | agent (Fly), web (Vercel), local | agent, web, local | secret | — | `openssl rand -hex 32` | SAME value on agent and web: web OAuth callback → agent `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/gmail` |
| `AGENT_API_SHARED_SECRET` | web (Vercel) | optional | secret | — | — | legacy alias read by web only if PERSONA_INTERNAL_SECRET is unset — do not set |
| `PERSONA_TOKEN_ENCRYPT_KEY` | agent (Fly), local | agent, local | secret | — | `python3 -c "import base64,os;print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(32)).decode())"` | AES-GCM key for Google refresh tokens at rest (agent/gmail/crypto.py). Rotating it strands stored tokens |

## Voice (Deepgram / Cartesia / call policy)

| Variable | Component | Required | Secret | Default | How to get / generate | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY` | agent (Fly) | agent | secret | — | console.deepgram.com → API keys | STT (+ Deepgram TTS failover); without it voice mode is `unavailable` |
| `DEEPGRAM_STT_MODEL` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `nova-3` | — | — |
| `DEEPGRAM_TTS_VOICE` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `aura-2-thalia-en` | — | failover TTS voice |
| `CARTESIA_API_KEY` | agent (Fly) | agent | secret | — | play.cartesia.ai → API keys | primary TTS |
| `CARTESIA_VOICE_ID` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `71a7ad14-091c-4e8e-a314-022ece01c121` | — | — |
| `CARTESIA_MODEL` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `sonic-2` | — | — |
| `PERSONA_VOICE_MAX_CALL_SECS` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `900` | — | hard cap per call (spend guard) |
| `PERSONA_VOICE_STUB_LLM` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | — | — | test-only: canned LLM on the call **Forbidden on agent.** |
| `PERSONA_VOICE_FAKE_VENDORS` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | — | — | test-only: offline tone TTS, no STT **Forbidden on agent.** |
| `PERSONA_SILENCE_NUDGE_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `7` | — | silence floor: first nudge |
| `PERSONA_SILENCE_EXAMPLE_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `15` | — | silence floor: example prompt |
| `PERSONA_SILENCE_PARK_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `23` | — | silence floor: park the call |
| `PERSONA_CALL_LEASE_TTL_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `120` | — | call lease TTL |
| `PERSONA_CALL_HEARTBEAT_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `30` | — | call heartbeat interval |
| `PERSONA_CALL_GRACE_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `20` | — | reconnect grace window (EC-04) |
| `PERSONA_WARMUP_TIMEOUT_S` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `20` | — | agent.main boot warmup budget (seconds); best-effort, time-boxed |

## ICE / TURN

| Variable | Component | Required | Secret | Default | How to get / generate | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CLOUDFLARE_TURN_KEY_ID` | agent (Fly) | agent | no | — | Cloudflare dashboard → Realtime → TURN → create key (see scripts/deploy/cloudflare-turn.md) | with the token: short-lived TURN creds minted per call for both legs (ADR 0001) |
| `CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN` | agent (Fly) | agent | secret | — | shown once when the TURN key is created | — |
| `PERSONA_TURN_URLS` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | — | — | static TURN alternative (Twilio/metered), comma-separated; used only if Cloudflare vars are unset |
| `PERSONA_TURN_USERNAME` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | — | — | static TURN username |
| `PERSONA_TURN_CREDENTIAL` | agent (Fly) | optional | secret | — | — | static TURN credential |
| `PERSONA_STUN_URLS` | agent (Fly) | optional | no | `stun:stun.l.google.com:19302` | — | — |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_ICE_URLS` | web (Vercel) | optional | public | `stun:stun.l.google.com:19302` | — | PUBLIC, inlined at `next build` (set before deploy). Browser fallback ICE; `none` = host-only. Never put TURN creds here |

## Google OAuth

| Variable | Component | Required | Secret | Default | How to get / generate | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` | agent (Fly), web (Vercel) | agent, web | no | — | Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client (Web). See scripts/deploy/google-oauth.md | — |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | agent (Fly), web (Vercel) | agent, web | secret | — | — | web: code exchange; agent: refresh-token refresh |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URL` | web (Vercel) | optional | no | `<origin>/api/oauth/google/callback` | — | pin to `https://<vercel-domain>/api/oauth/google/callback` so preview URLs can't drift |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_AUTH_URL` | web (Vercel) | optional | no | `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth` | — | test-only override (e2e Google double) **Forbidden on web.** |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL` | web (Vercel) | optional | no | `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` | — | test-only override **Forbidden on web.** |
| `GOOGLE_OAUTH_ISSUER` | web (Vercel) | optional | no | `accounts.google.com` | — | test-only override **Forbidden on web.** |
